generations.zh: 当前代旗舰 Flash 线。官方定位「Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression」，MIT 许可。
generations.en: Current Flash-line flagship. Positioned as "Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression"; MIT-licensed.

generations.zh: V4 代两个分支：Flash（0731）与 Pro（0813）；本站收录的 deepseek-v4 系列在 V4.1-Flash 上。
generations.en: Two branches of the V4 generation: Flash (0731) and Pro (0813). This site's deepseek-v4 series tracks V4.1-Flash.

generations.zh: 上一代主力（V3 系），MoE + 稀疏注意力路线从这一代开始成型。
generations.en: Previous mainline generation (V3 series); the MoE plus sparse-attention approach took shape here.

sizeTiers.zh: 单一MoE大杯：552B 骨干参数（官方 README 口径），本地可跑性依赖量化与内存
sizeTiers.en: Single MoE tier: 552B backbone parameters (official README); local runability depends on quantisation and memory

claims.zh: 官方 README：「a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens」——多模态 MoE、上下文上限 100 万 token。
claims.en: Official README: "a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens".

claims.zh: 官方 README：CED 架构下每 token 预填充激活 8B 参数、解码激活 16B（「8B parameters per token during prefill and 16B during decode」）。
claims.en: Official README: under the CED architecture, 8B parameters activate per token during prefill and 16B during decode.

positioning.zh: MIT 许可 + KV cache 压缩路线鲜明；量化生态活跃（llama.cpp 作者亲自维护过其量化版，本站系列页有记录）。适合追新、能接受大模型的部署者。
positioning.en: MIT-licensed with a distinctive KV-cache-compression roadmap; an active quantisation ecosystem. For deployers who track the frontier and can host large models.

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的量化对比（1 个模型仓 / 11 个量化档）
onSite.en: This site covers DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash quantisations (1 repo / 11 tiers)
